info.title: Turnstile 360 People and Scoped Access
info.description: Executable user-management contracts. UM-I04 supplies canonical access consumers; UM-I05 implements scoped structure operations; UM-I08 implements restricted recipients; UM-I09 implements ordinary administration reads, impact, commands and current readback. Authority integration is implemented in UM-I06. Ordinary writers remain closed behind the coordinated release gate. This document does not deploy or open capabilities. Semantic Zod refinements, including normalization/applicability/versions, are normative beyond structural JSON Schema.

x-implementation-status: UM-I05 structure, UM-I08 recipient and UM-I09 administration operations implemented; ordinary feature writers gated

get.description: Live normal shell session; completed workspace; company people OR role management. Catalog availability requires owning backend implementation. Runtime reference, grant-ceiling and transactional checks remain mandatory after structural validation.
